title: ESP
features:
ESP for SCP Demonstration. (CURRENTLY DISABLED)
PC Only, Will add mobile support soon (you can activate it by tapping but currently you can't move it out of the way)
Has name and HP esp, it's always visible so you can't disable it.
For MTF, CI or SCP teams, it won't show the name of the player, instead it'll just say the name of their team and their hp.
has a highlight esp that can be toggled with left ctrl.
The highlight will only highlight those who can damage you or who you can damage.
If you have TeamKill enabled on the options of the game, and someone else also has, it will also highlight them.
you can toggle for it to highlight everyone no matter if they can damage you or not by pressing Y.
even if Y is disabled, you can still know where others are because the text is always visible, and the highlight esp and text esp has a radius of 200, above that it won't show anything.
There's a draggable text that says if the highlight esp is on or off you can drag it wherever you want to.
